title: Mystic River
author: Dennis Lehane
summary: Three boys from a Boston neighbourhood are changed forever when one is abducted. Decades later, one friend's daughter is murdered, and the police detective on the case is another of the three.
readIf: you want a crime novel that cares more about grief, class and old wounds than about clever clues.
skipIf: you are sensitive to stories involving harm to children, or want a light read.

pairings.reason: A detective haunted by a childhood event that echoes in the case he is working.
A steadier, more procedural crime story with a similarly weary, human tone.
Also about a murdered girl, told with more tenderness and attention to those left behind.
